findings.observation: Facts.md confirms Collier Street is classified as '2U-OP (2-lane undivided, on-pavement)' - an undivided street. The subject site fronts Collier Street on its north side. Used vision_check on Sheet 15 along Collier Street. Vision confirmed that while driveway widths are dimensioned, there are no dimension lines indicating offset distances between driveways on opposite sides of Collier Street. Vision_check on Sheet 13 confirmed no driveways are shown on the north side of Collier Street (the side opposite the subject site).
findings.reasoning: The condition 'If site fronts undivided street' is met (Collier Street is undivided per facts.md). The deficiency states 'Offsets from opposing driveways not dimensioned on undivided street frontage.' For undivided streets, Transportation requires offset dimensions to ensure safe sight distances and avoid vehicles turning into/out of opposing driveways simultaneously. Since no opposing driveways are shown on the plans and no offset dimensions are provided, the requirement cannot be verified as met. This is a failure because the plans must either show opposing driveways with offset dimensions, or demonstrate that no opposing driveways exist within the relevant distance.
findings.explanation: No offset dimensions shown between subject site driveways and opposing driveways on north side of Collier Street; opposing driveways not depicted.
